corrects_or_narrows.statement_to_narrow: The Experiment Lab module contract says station results are deterministic for identical parameters; the checkpoint correctly identifies nondeterministic fallback parameter generation but does not explicitly record a second nondeterminism inside an individual station path.

source_crosscheck.module_contract: Results are deterministic given the same parameters.
source_crosscheck.counterexample: QuantumStation world_model simulation initializes numpy RandomState from int(time.time()) % 10000, so the same explicit params can produce different world_model trajectories across runs unless time happens to map to the same seed.

changes: Do not grant deterministic-simulation credit from module-level prose or station class identity.
Every stochastic source, including internal station RNG construction, must be explicit in ExperimentPlan as seed + RNG algorithm/build identity before execution.
A simulator that reads wall-clock time, ambient randomness, mutable global state or unbound external state is NON_REPLAYABLE until those inputs are captured and bound.
Replay acceptance requires identical normalized params + seed + simulator/build/source digest + assumptions to reproduce the declared structured observable within its predeclared tolerance.
Narration remains presentation only and cannot repair or hide nondeterministic result identity.

cheap_discriminator_for_triggerword4.name: SimulationReplayIdentityTest/v1
cheap_discriminator_for_triggerword4.procedure: For each retained station/submode, static-scan and runtime-instrument all RNG/time/ambient-state reads; require a bound seed/input manifest, then repeat exact TestPlan twice and compare structured result digest or declared numeric tolerance. The world_model time-seed path must fail before repair.
